caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a male figure standing upright on a rounded base. The figure is draped in a long, brown garment that covers his left shoulder and arm, leaving part of his right leg and arm exposed. The garment features detailed folds that suggest its texture and weight. The man's right arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand positioned near the chest and holding what appears to be a roll or scroll. His legs are positioned such that his left leg is straight while his right leg is bent at the knee and slightly forward. The statue's base displays rough, irregular shapes and includes some hints of greenish-blue coloration. The figure's face has short, curly hair and a beard, and the expression appears neutral, with eyes looking forward. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery included.
title: Figurehead: "Hercules"
